description_summary: Native Android client for the live ForgeHouse 50 web app (forgehouse50.pages.dev, Cloudflare Pages+Workers+D1). Church NT 50-reading-day programme: per-user schedules (Tue/Fri excluded), VerseWell scripture text+audio, notes, one-attempt proportional quiz, points/badges, confidence-weighted leaderboard + final results, admin dashboard, Brevo OTP email auth. Same backend, same API routes as the web app at github.com/vjumbo264/forgehouse50.

backend.auth: email/password signup -> 6-digit OTP via Brevo -> verify -> fh50_session cookie (HttpOnly, 30d). Android client stores token in EncryptedSharedPreferences and sends it as Cookie header fh50_session=<token>.
backend.key_rules: Quiz: ONE attempt, no gate, no timer, proportional points (score/total)*5. Completion: POST /api/read/complete (sequential days, max 1 day read-ahead). Leaderboard eligibility: elapsed_days>=3 on user's own calendar; overall uses damped score (raw_avg*elapsed)/(elapsed+7). Admin accounts cannot participate. Translations served by VerseWell mirror only.

tasks.name: sr-diagnose-root-cause
tasks.notes: ROOT CAUSE (source-level, conclusive): ReadScreen.kt passage/audio LaunchedEffect keyed on (day, selected, translation) with `if (!dayLoaded) return@LaunchedEffect`. dayLoaded is NOT a key, so for any returning user (stored translationId set -> translation state never changes) the effect runs exactly once at composition, early-returns before day data arrives, and NEVER re-fires. getPassage() and audioAvailability() are simply never called -> blank pane, no audio bar, forever. v5 only gated the spinner on dayLoaded, converting an infinite spinner into a silent permanent blank. Secondary defects: stale/invalid stored translation id never validated against live /translations; passage failure surfaces only as a tiny top banner with no retry; leaderboard app reads e.value (potentially averaged) instead of explicit total_points; SharedPreferences leaderboard cache can serve pre-fix payloads.

tasks.name: sr-rewire-readscreen-load
tasks.notes: DONE. ReadScreen.kt rewired: passage+audio effect now keyed on the assignment identity (book:chapter_start:chapter_end) + the validated translation + a manual reload token, so it ALWAYS re-fires when day data lands / chip switch / translation change / Retry. The previous never-firing effect (keyed without dayLoaded, early-returning before day data arrived) is gone. loadingPassage is cleared on every path; passage failure renders a dedicated, retryable error view in the pane (no silent blank / no endless spinner); stored translation id is validated against live /translations with fallback to the first versewell id; an audio-availability failure now only hides the audio bar and never takes the passage down.
